title: Puzzle 3D Context Menu Suggest Stays Off Brush
description: puzzle 3d: When suggesting objects via context menu dont change the active tool and dont get into brush mode. It is just a single suggestion.
summary: Context-menu / Alt+right-click "Suggest objects" is now a one-shot placement: openVortexSuggestions no longer switches into brush, acceptSuggestion no longer resets the host utility/tool, and world_brush_preview_json still emits the ghost while the suggestion popup is open. Extended regressions cover no SetActiveUtility/SetActiveTool effects, preserved transform utility across open+accept, live hover preview without brush mode, and successful accept while staying in select. Verified with focused puzzle-plugin lib tests (open/close/preserve/hover/accept).
